description: Job openings from the Arbeitnow public job board API (mostly Europe, many remote roles). Returns the newest 300 postings; title, company, location, remote flag, tags, posted time, link. No salary field in the source. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_ashby when you need open roles from one company's public Ashby job board; jobs_greenhouse when you need open roles from one company's public Greenhouse job board. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: jobs_arbeitnow
title: Job openings from the Arbeitnow public job board API.
